name: Allegro MicroSystems
outlook:
What Allegro MicroSystems says to expect

  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: net salesFor the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 ending December 25, 2026, the Company expects total net sales to be in the range of $278 million to $288 million.
  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: gross margin• Gross Margin is expected to be between 51.5% and 52.5%,
  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: diluted earnings per share• Diluted Earnings per Share is expected to be between $0.25 and $0.29, with the mid-point of this range implying an 80% year-over-year increase.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
